summary: Third-pass regression + 3 new features verified. Backend pytest 15/15 pass. Playwright E2E: PDF/print buttons trigger window.print(), @media print hides nav/hero-ctas/footer, TTS speak() called on Colors game with correct word, /certificate renders for eligible user with name/stars/date, cert-print+cert-back work, /map shows cert-cta only when 7 levels complete, /certificate shows cert-gate + auto-redirect for ineligible users, cookie-only auth still intact (localStorage.ek_token=null).
critical_code_review_comments: TTS lib silent-fails when window.speechSynthesis absent (SpeakButton returns null, speak() no-ops) — good defensive design.
Certificate gate uses setTimeout(2500ms) then navigate; timer cleaned up in useEffect return — no leak.
cert-cta uses progress.length === LEVELS.length; correct because backend prevents duplicate level entries.
test_credentials: test@ek.com / test1234 (7 levels completed, 21 stars). Fresh users registered dynamically for cert-gate test.
seed_data_creation: None; used pre-seeded test user + on-the-fly registration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 features from third pass verified end-to-end: (1) PDF/print via window.print() on hero-cta-print, cta-print-pdf, cert-print; (2) @media print CSS hides nav/hero-ctas/footer (computed display:none confirmed via emulate_media); (3) certificate flow — gate+auto-redirect for ineligible, full render for eligible (name='Test', 21/21 stars, Spanish date '14 de julio de 2026'), cert-back returns to /map; (4) TTS Colors game — speak-btn present, click invokes window.speechSynthesis.speak with utterance.text='Green'. Regression: cookie-only auth still holds (ek_token in localStorage is null). Backend 15/15 pytest green.
